body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-09. The published wiki has 15 pages. These seven are NOT among them:

    Install-on-QNAP            Install-on-Unraid
    Install-on-Synology        Install-with-Docker-Compose
    Install-on-TrueNAS-SCALE   Install-with-Dockge
    Install-with-Portainer

All seven exist and are maintained in `repo/wiki-src/`. They have never been
published. For a self-hosted product these are close to the highest-intent pages
we have — someone searching "calibre-web nextgen unraid" gets nothing.

Cause: there are TWO parallel wiki pipelines and the autopilot runs the stale one.

    autopilot-tick.sh step 5b2  ->  $ROOT/scripts/sync-wiki.sh --apply
    outer scripts/sync-wiki.sh  ->  $PROJ/scripts/generate-wiki.py  (Jul  4, 311 lines)
                                    --src $PROJ/wiki-src            (15 templates, UNTRACKED)

    repo/scripts/sync-wiki.sh   ->  repo/scripts/generate-wiki.py   (Jul 15, 326 lines)
                                    --src repo/wiki-src             (22 templates, tracked)

The outer `wiki-src/` is a strict SUBSET of the repo one — nothing is only-in-outer —
and it is untracked/gitignored, so it is a stale local copy that no longer receives
edits. The seven missing pages are exactly the seven templates absent from it.

Compounding it: the outer generator has **zero** support for the `#__document__`
transclusion directive (`grep -c __document__` = 0 vs 4 in the repo copy), and eight
repo templates depend on it — the seven install guides plus `Kobo-Sync.md`. So even
if the templates were copied across, the stale generator could not render them.

Consequences beyond the missing pages:
- Any wiki edit made in `repo/wiki-src/` is silently ignored by the autopilot, which
  reads a different directory. An author sees their file committed and never
  published, with no error.
- A page using `#__document__` fails under the outer generator. That reads as a
  content bug and sends you looking at the template rather than the stale script.

Fix: delete the outer duplicate and point `scripts/sync-wiki.sh` at the repo copies
of BOTH the generator and `wiki-src/`, so there is one tracked source of truth. Then
re-run the sync and confirm the seven pages appear. Do NOT fix by copying the newer
generator outward — that recreates the same divergence with a fresher timestamp.

Verification used here: cloned the live wiki and listed pages, rather than inferring
publication from the templates existing.
title: Seven install guides are written but have never reached the wiki: the autopilot renders from a stale untracked copy
